preconditions: Private native Linux work storage, independently trusted initial work and original ChangePlan, current owned target model and policy, test-owned registered normative contract and an explicit recorded-build fixture.
steps: Persist original plan and authoring bindings in initial and successive work data; perform a fresh read-only normative resume diagnostic without executing a handler.
Check retained original bytes and IDs, reject changed current identity or actual target basis, and require the separate final native-lock writer gate.

oracle.requirement_contract: Ein normativer Gesamtauftrag MUSS über alle seine Arbeitsschritte dieselbe fachliche Request-ID verwenden.
oracle.scope: 6.m.R adds exact original ChangePlan bytes and plan/operation/actor/request bindings to the inert normative work codec. The read-only normative resume preflight uses the current recorded build, trusted host registry, protected project root, original authoring identity and the existing publication diagnostic against current model and actual filesystem bytes/rights. Different actor, request or project bindings and stale target state conflict without rebase or work writes. This is diagnostic preparation only: no normative handler executes, write_authorized remains false, and the existing final authorization and recheck under the real project writer lock are mandatory. It also validates saved read-only completion schemas, declared handler exit codes and diagnostics before a writer lease, and refuses runtime identity changes before confirmation. Work remains running. General work-resume CLI/Code-8 integration, normative execution, multi-unit execution, portable copy/restore and full work completion remain open; no complete requirement or release pass is asserted. 6.m.C separates independently bound initial/checkpoint restoration from the fresh local identity/target/rights check. Extracted check statements and their order remain unchanged, with the same work mutex retained through final readback. Public result and error contracts, stored bytes and read-only execution are unchanged. Existing behavior tests are retained byte-for-byte; no additional command, authorization or completion claim is introduced.

open_items: General work-resume CLI/Code-8 and closure integration, normative execution under the final authorizing writer gate, multi-unit execution and portable copy/restore remain open. Stored normative plan bindings and fresh read-only diagnostics are partial coverage, not write authority.
